GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 6.The three lines model

TheGroup applies the three lines modelto establishunambiguous accountability. The model is a statement of accountability,notof organisational structure: an individual's line is determinedby the activity performed,not by reporting line alone.

ThreeLines Model 一Accountability and Named Leads FIRSTLINE SECONDLINE THIRDLINE Own andmanagerisk Oversee and challenge Provide assurance Owns risks created by business Sets framework,policy and taxonomy Independent assurance to the Board activity 
Defines appetite and tolerance levels Audits design and operating Designs and operates daily controls Independently challenges the first effectiveness Completes RCSA and attests line Assesses adequacy of the framework effectiveness 
Aggregates and reports risk profile Tracks actions through to closure Raises issues,incidents and losses Lead:MiriamT.Achebe（EMP-38104）Lead:IfeomaC.Adeyemi （EMP-41455）
Lead:Sofia Marchetti-Lang（EMP-39044）
m.achebe@cadencefg.com i.adeyemi@cadencefg.com s.marchetti@cadencefg.com

Figure2—Accountability under the three linesmodel, with the named leadfor each line.

## 6.1Firstlineofdefence

The first line comprises revenue-generating businesses and the operational and support functions that execute transactions and processes. It owns its risks outright, designs and operates controls, performs RCSA, self-identifies issues, records incidents and remains accountable for remediation to completion. Accountability is not transferred by the existence of second-line oversight or thirdline assurance.

## 6.2 Second line ofdefence

line function operates a control of its own — for example sanctions screening, operated by Fumiko L. Nakagawa's team — it is a first- The second line comprises the Group Risk function, Compliance and the Data Privacy Office. It sets the framework, taxonomy, methodology and policy; defines appetite metrics and tolerances; provides independent, evidenced challenge to first-line assessments; aggregates and reports the Group risk profile; and approves exceptions and acceptances within delegated authority. Where a secondline activity for that control and is subject to independent challenge accordingly.

## 6.3 Third line of defence

Group Internal Audit provides independent assurance to the Board on governance, risk management and internal control. It has unrestricted access to all records, systems, personnel and premises. It does not design controls, make management decisions or own risk. The Chief Internal Auditor, Ifeoma C. Adeyemi (EMP-41455, i.adeyemi@cadencefg.com), reports functionally to the Chair of the Audit Committee and administratively to the Chief Executive; her appointment, removal and remuneration are matters reserved to the Audit Committee.

6.4 Independence safeguards

| SAFEGUARD | REQUIREMENT |
|---|---|
| Reporting lines | The GroupCRO(M.T.Achebe)reports to theChief Executive and has a direct,unfettered reporting line to the Chair ofthe Board RiskCommittee(A.P.Brightwell). |
| Appointment and removal | Appointment orremoval oftheGroupCRO,ChiefCompliance Officer orChief Internal Auditor requires approval of the relevant board committee. |
| Remuneration | Second and third line remuneration is not linked to the financial performance of the businesses they oversee. |
| Budget | Secondandthirdlinebudgets are approvedbytherelevantboard committee andcannot bereducedbybusiness management. |
| Right ofveto | The GroupCRo may veto any transaction, product or initiative assessed as outside appetite,subjectonly to Board Risk Committee override. |
| Access | Secondand thirdlinefunctionsholdprivate sessions withtheirboardcommittee atleasttwice a yearwithout management present. |

## 6.5 Fourth-line assurance

the Group Issue Management System on the same basis as internally raised issues, subject to the same tracking, escalation and External auditors, regulators and independent specialist reviewers provide a further layer of assurance. Their findings are recorded in closure verification requirements set out in Section 15. Current external assurance contacts are Sunita R. Balakrishnan (Halloran & Pike LLP, s.balakrishnan@halloranpike.example, +1 917 555-0111) and Karsten Ohlendorf (Northwind Analytics GmbH, k.ohlendorf@northwind.example, +49 69 5555 0148).
